ID: W-1041
Title: Fix discount rounding
Description: Discount calculations are losing cents. When a 10% discount on $99.99 is calculated, it should round to nearest cent using banker's rounding (round half to even), not floor.
Linked files: acme/billing.py
Acceptance: 10% discount on $99.99 cents yields $89.99, not $89.98

content.text:
Perfect! W-1041 is now complete. Here's what I did:

**Summary:**
- Fixed the `apply_discount()` function in `acme/billing.py` to use banker's rounding instead of `math.floor()`
- Changed `int(math.floor(discount_amount))` to `round(discount_amount)` to properly round fractional cents
- Verified the acceptance criteria: 10% discount on $99.99 now correctly yields $89.99
- All tests pass and CI checks complete successfully
- Committed the changes with proper attribution

The discount rounding now correctly handles fractional cent amounts using banker's rounding (round half to even) instead of always rounding down.
